description: Use this when the user asks about HTTP response headers or security headers of a page (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, cookies). Returns every header and a grade A+ to F with the exact header to add. Read-only, powered by Lanetti Tools.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com/path. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.
